name: Set organic account and platform strategy
human_role: social media manager setting the platform plan for the quarter
inputs_required: brand brain: avatars, category, region, voice

steps.name: Read the avatar and voice
steps.does: Pull avatar age band, region, language and where they already spend time online from the brand brain.
steps.check: summary names a real age band and region, not a generic buyer
steps.ask_founder_if: the avatar section is missing or older than 6 months

steps.name: Pull the competitive teardown
steps.does: Get structure-only notes on which platforms 3-5 close competitors run, cadence and format mix.
steps.check: table names structure only, no copied text

steps.name: Score each candidate platform
steps.does: Score avatar fit, production cost, and set a 2-week trial success bar for anything new.
tools: script: none, scored in the agent
steps.output: scored platform table with trial bars
steps.check: every new platform has a stated success bar and kill date

steps.name: Set content pillars
steps.does: Set 3-5 pillars, each naming a SKU and the objection it answers.
steps.check: every pillar names a SKU and an objection

steps.name: Lock the visual world
steps.does: Set palette, type and caption style against the brand's approved assets so every account matches.
steps.check: spec matches approved brand assets, not a new look
steps.ask_founder_if: no approved brand asset file exists yet

steps.name: Write the account setup checklist
steps.does: Bio, link-in-bio, contact, category tag, WhatsApp Business link, per platform.
steps.check: every field has a real value, no placeholder

steps.name: Check platform-policy compliance
steps.does: Check disclosure and content-policy requirements per platform (synthetic voice, sponsored, minors in ads).
steps.check: every platform's current policy checked, not last year's

steps.name: Package the founder card
steps.does: Turn the plan into a plain-English card for any new account, platform drop, or account-type change.
steps.check: card has 3 sentences and clear buttons

steps.name: Log the decision
steps.does: Record the founder's decision and reason in the registry.
steps.check: reason stored verbatim

qa: Every pillar names a SKU and objection
No platform runs past its trial date without a decision
read_point: at the trial kill date for any new platform, else quarterly
typical_duration: agent: 2-3 hours; founder decision: same day to 1 week

name: Build the monthly content calendar, scripts and shoot plan
human_role: content strategist and social media manager building the month's postable plan
inputs_required: brand brain: pillars, SKUs, stock status, voice, claims tiers

steps.name: Mine buyer and avatar questions
steps.does: Pull the ranked question bank from support tickets, DMs, reviews and Search Console.
steps.check: every question has a quoted source and date

steps.name: Set the posting floor and cadence
steps.does: Set a minimum weekly post count per platform the team can hold without burning out, based on last month's actual delivery rate.
steps.check: floor is at or below what was actually delivered last month, not aspirational

steps.name: Sequence SKUs and stock moments
steps.does: Slot SKUs against current and projected stock status so no post promotes an item going out of stock mid-run.
steps.check: no slot promotes a SKU with a stock-out inside the post's live window

steps.name: Add the festive and regional layer
steps.does: Map Diwali, Holi, regional festivals and shipping cutoffs onto the calendar, tagging language variant per slot.
steps.check: no post promises delivery the warehouse cannot hit

steps.name: Set the fair test window
steps.does: Give the calendar a stated run length before judging it, tied to the store's own baseline.
steps.check: window is stated in dates, not 'a while'

steps.name: Plan founder camera time and batching
steps.does: Confirm the founder's available shoot days, set fixed batching days, and pick fast-turnaround formats for founder-only days.
steps.check: every founder-dependent slot has a confirmed date or is flagged
steps.ask_founder_if: the founder has not confirmed available days for the month

steps.name: Write scripts, hooks and captions
steps.does: For every slot, dispatch to the matching make-content child by format and platform.
steps.output: draft per slot: hook, body, caption, CTA, claims used
steps.check: every draft names one SKU and one buyer, reading level under grade 10

steps.name: Build shot lists
steps.does: For video and carousel slots, confirm the shot list or slide list is filmable/designable without a follow-up question.
steps.check: shot seconds sum to target length; slide count 5-9

steps.name: Run the claims gate
steps.does: Check every draft's factual claims against the claims tiers.
steps.check: zero untraced claims remain

steps.name: Route destinations
steps.does: Confirm every slot's link or Story tag points to a live, matching page before it is scheduled.
steps.check: destination confirmed live at check time, not assumed

steps.name: Assemble the final calendar
steps.does: Merge cadence, SKU sequencing, festive layer, scripts, shot lists and destination checks into one dated calendar.
steps.output: dated calendar rows: platform, pillar, SKU, format, hook, funnel stage, status
steps.check: every row has a status and a funnel-stage tag

steps.name: Log the plan
steps.does: Register the month's plan and its success bar in the registry for the next performance read to compare against.
steps.check: metric and read point are contract fields, not invented

qa: Every slot has a named SKU, buyer, claims-checked draft and destination pass
Cadence floor matches actual delivered capacity
Festive dates checked against shipping cutoffs
read_point: end of the stated test window, against the store's own baseline
typical_duration: agent: 1-2 days; founder review and shoot days: 1-2 weeks
subagents: content-production-worker: bulk script drafting across slots

name: Keep the idea bank fed and design repeatable formats
trigger: weekly, or when the idea bank runs low, or after a post clearly outperforms
human_role: content strategist mining ideas and naming winning formats

steps.name: Mine comments and DMs
steps.does: Pull recurring questions, jokes and requests from the last week's comments and DMs.
steps.check: each idea has a source quote

steps.name: Mine product facts and founder stories
steps.does: Pull first-hand material from the product facts sheet and founder story log.
steps.check: each idea is something a competitor cannot simply restate

steps.name: Tear down competitor and category posts
steps.does: Review 5-10 public competitor/category posts for pacing, hook type and shot count only.
steps.output: teardown notes: structure and mood only
steps.check: no copied words, logos, products or faces

steps.name: Check recent performance for a repeatable winner
steps.does: Compare recent posts to the account's own baseline for a clear outperformer.
steps.check: comparison uses the account's own baseline, not an industry number

steps.name: Name and template the format
steps.does: If a winner qualifies, name it and write a fixed template a team member can run without the founder.
steps.check: template states what makes it runnable without the founder

steps.name: Rank the new ideas
steps.does: Rank all new idea stubs for calendar priority.
steps.check: no arithmetic done outside code

steps.name: Add to the idea bank
steps.does: Log every new idea and format with source and date.
steps.check: every entry has a source and date

outputs: a new named format (when one qualifies)
qa: Every idea traces to a real source
No competitor material copied beyond structure/mood
New format states its without-founder runnability
read_point: next monthly performance read, watching whether the new format repeats its result

name: Draft daily community replies
human_role: community manager clearing the comment and DM queue

steps.name: Pull and sort the queue
steps.does: Sort into product question, complaint, praise, spam/bot, sales-ready lead.
steps.check: every item has exactly one type

steps.name: Draft product-question replies
steps.does: Write a specific answer with a page link where relevant.
steps.check: no generic templated reply on a specific question

steps.name: Draft complaint replies
steps.does: Acknowledge specifically and give a real next step.
steps.check: every complaint reply names a concrete next step

steps.name: Draft sales-ready lead replies
steps.does: Write the reply plus the DM hand-off line into any approved funnel.
steps.check: hand-off line matches the approved funnel design

steps.name: Check DM automation policy
steps.does: Check any DM automation in use against current platform rate-limit and disclosure rules.
steps.check: checked against current policy, not an assumption

steps.name: Flag founder items
steps.does: Flag PR risk, refund exceptions or legal threats for the founder instead of drafting a reply.
steps.check: nothing risky is drafted and sent without a flag

steps.name: Queue for human send
steps.does: Package all drafts for a human to review and send.
steps.check: every drafted reply has a type and a next step

qa: No generic reply on a specific question
DM automation checked against current policy
Every complaint reply names a next step
read_point: daily, response time and resolution tracked weekly
typical_duration: agent: 30-60 minutes; human send: same day

name: Design the comment-to-DM and lead-magnet funnel
human_role: social media manager designing how a post captures a stranger as a contact

steps.name: Confirm the lead magnet matches a real want
steps.does: Check the offer against the buyer-question map for evidence buyers actually asked for it.
steps.check: traces to a real, quoted buyer want, not a generic discount

steps.name: Design the DM flow
steps.does: Set the trigger keyword, auto-reply copy and human hand-off point.
steps.check: hand-off point is named, not open-ended

steps.name: Check platform policy
steps.does: Check the flow against current Meta/Instagram DM-automation policy.
steps.check: checked against current policy

steps.name: Design the viral-spike overflow plan
steps.does: Set the comment velocity that needs a human on standby and the overflow message.
steps.check: a specific velocity threshold is named

steps.name: Map the destination
steps.does: Decide where the captured contact lands (WhatsApp, email, CRM) and hand the after-capture sequence to Lifecycle.
steps.check: Lifecycle is named as the owner of what happens after capture

steps.name: Package the founder card
steps.does: Present cost, automation, and platform-policy risk.
steps.check: card names cost and risk plainly

steps.name: Log the decision
steps.does: Record the founder's decision.
steps.check: reason stored verbatim

qa: Lead magnet is evidenced, not generic
read_point: 4 weeks after launch: capture rate and DM response time
typical_duration: agent: half a day; founder decision: same day to 1 week

name: Repurpose UGC and reviews into content
human_role: content strategist turning proof into postable content

steps.name: Pull new verified proof
steps.does: Pull new verified reviews, photos and unboxing videos since the last run.
steps.check: only items with real text or footage, not a bare star

steps.name: Check usage rights
steps.does: Confirm each item's usage rights against the buyer or creator agreement.
steps.check: nothing unconfirmed proceeds without founder permission
steps.ask_founder_if: usage rights are unconfirmed for a strong piece of content

steps.name: Pick the strongest proof per SKU
steps.does: Select the most specific quotes and images per SKU.
steps.check: specific detail beats generic praise

steps.name: Draft the content
steps.does: Dispatch to make-content for the matching format (quote card, stitched reel, before/after).
steps.check: source credit matches the agreement

steps.name: Run the claims gate on restated claims
steps.does: Check any customer claim restated as a brand claim against the claims tiers.
steps.check: a customer opinion is never assumed to be an approved claim

steps.name: Add to the calendar and library
steps.does: Tag by SKU and funnel stage, add to the asset library.
steps.check: every draft is tagged

qa: No content used without confirmed rights
Every draft tagged by SKU and funnel stage
read_point: next monthly performance read, UGC-tagged post performance vs baseline

name: Run pre-publish destination and funnel-stage QA
human_role: social media manager's final check before anything goes live

steps.name: Open the destination
steps.does: Open the post's link or Story product tag directly.
steps.check: checked live, not assumed

steps.name: Confirm the page matches the promise
steps.does: Confirm live, matching product/offer, honest stock or waitlist state.
steps.check: stock state is honest, not defaulted to in-stock

steps.name: Confirm price and offer match exactly
steps.does: Compare the post's stated price/offer to the live page.
steps.check: exact match required, not approximate

steps.name: Tag the funnel stage
steps.does: Tag the post awareness, consideration, decision or retention.
steps.check: every post gets exactly one tag

steps.name: Pass or hold
steps.does: Pass the post or hold it with the specific mismatch reason.
steps.check: a hold names the exact mismatch

steps.name: Log a held post
steps.does: When a post is held, log the reason and notify the calendar owner so the slot is fixed or rescheduled, not silently dropped.
steps.check: every hold has a logged reason and an owner notified

qa: Destination checked live at the moment
Every passing post carries a funnel-stage tag
read_point: immediately, before publish

name: Run the content lifecycle: reuse and retire
human_role: content strategist managing the asset library's shelf life
inputs_required: content/asset library with tags and dates

steps.name: Pull the library
steps.does: Pull every asset with publish date, SKU tag and format.
steps.check: every asset has a date and tag

steps.name: Apply shelf-life rules
steps.does: Apply the right rule per asset type (seasonal, price-specific, evergreen).
steps.check: no default rule applied without checking the asset type

steps.name: Find reuse slots
steps.does: Find unused reuse slots for still-valid assets: PDP, email, DM, post-purchase.
steps.check: each candidate names a specific surface

steps.name: Mark retirements
steps.does: Mark expired assets and list every surface they still appear on.
steps.check: retirement covers every surface, not just the origin post

steps.name: Hand off reuse and retirement
steps.does: Send reuse candidates to the calendar and retirement list to the surface owners (Site for PDP, Life for email).
steps.check: each item has a named owner

steps.name: Log the cycle
steps.does: Register how many assets were reused, retired and where, for the next monthly performance read.
steps.check: counts are real, not estimated

qa: Every asset has a shelf-life rule applied
Price/stock content never stays live past accuracy
read_point: next monthly performance read, checking reused assets' new-surface performance

name: Run creator discovery and seeding

human_role: a creator/community manager running organic gifting and seeding

steps.name: Scan for new creators
steps.does: Scan public Instagram, YouTube and Pinterest posts for creators discussing the category or named competitors without mentioning this brand.
steps.check: every candidate is a real public post, not inferred

steps.name: Score candidates

steps.name: Draft personalized outreach

steps.name: Batch for founder approval

steps.check: nothing sends without approval

steps.check: every brief has a rights ask on file before shipment

steps.name: Track delivery

steps.check: non-delivery is flagged, not dropped

steps.name: Feed content to the UGC pipeline

steps.name: Log the cycle
steps.does: Register cost, creators seeded and content yield.
steps.check: cost and yield are real numbers, not estimates

name: Read and report organic content performance

steps.name: Pull SKU/hook-level numbers
steps.does: Pull performance by SKU and hook from the metric contract.
steps.check: missing fields show as unavailable

steps.name: Compute the store's own baseline
steps.does: Compute the trailing-90-day median in code.
steps.check: computed in code, not estimated

name: Run social listening for brand, competitor and category trends

steps.name: Monitor mentions

steps.name: Classify mentions

steps.check: every mention gets a classification

steps.name: Track week-over-week trends
steps.does: Compare this week's counts to last week's to catch a real shift.
steps.check: trend claims require a week-over-week pattern

steps.name: Draft the digest

steps.check: every idea traces to a quoted, dated mention

steps.name: Route risk flags

name: Optimize money-page SEO: product and collection
human_role: an SEO manager writing and structuring the pages that sell

steps.name: Read the brief and page type
steps.does: Confirm whether the target is a product or a collection page.
steps.check: matches the store's real catalogue structure

steps.name: Write the title and meta description
steps.does: Write a real title and meta description covering the target term.
steps.check: title is readable, not a SKU code

steps.name: Build the content stack (product) or grid rules (collection)
steps.does: Build the fact-based content stack for a product page, or the grid/FAQ rules for a collection page.
steps.check: every claim site-backed; out-of-stock handling is honest

steps.name: Apply the right template
steps.does: Apply the subscription/variant template if needed, or standard collection template.
steps.check: subscription/variant products never use the default template

steps.name: Write image alt text
steps.does: Write alt text describing the actual product shown.
steps.check: alt text matches the actual image content

steps.name: Add FAQ and reviews
steps.does: Add real buyer questions and review data.
steps.check: questions trace to real sources

steps.name: Add internal links
steps.does: Add the links the brief specifies.
steps.check: links point to live, matching pages

steps.name: Run the claims gate
steps.does: Check every factual line.
steps.check: zero untraced claims

steps.name: Package the change list
steps.does: Package the page spec as a change list for the founder or Site to apply.
steps.check: rollback path stated

qa: Title readable, not a SKU code
read_point: next SEO reporting cycle, page-level revenue and ranking
typical_duration: agent: half a day per page

name: Implement and validate structured data
human_role: an SEO manager adding machine-readable facts to money pages

steps.name: Pick the schema types needed
steps.does: Decide which of Product, Review, FAQ, Breadcrumb, Offer apply.
steps.check: matches what the page actually contains

steps.name: Populate fields
steps.does: Populate every field from live data.
steps.check: no placeholder value

steps.name: Validate pre-deployment
steps.does: Run a structured-data testing tool.
steps.check: passes before shipping

steps.name: Choose the deployment path
steps.does: Use direct theme access or package as a GTM tag/trigger.
steps.check: GTM used whenever theme access is unavailable

steps.name: Write the developer brief
steps.does: Name the change, location, reason, check and rollback.
steps.check: rollback is one step

steps.name: Re-validate post-deployment
steps.does: After a human applies it, re-validate on the live page.
steps.check: confirmed live, not assumed

read_point: on deployment, rich-result eligibility checked
typical_duration: agent: half a day; human deployment: 1-3 days

name: Produce SEO content pages: clusters, guides and comparisons
trigger: monthly, ahead of the season a cluster targets
human_role: an SEO content writer building guide-format content with a real money page behind it

steps.name: Confirm the subtype and season
steps.does: Confirm buying guide or comparison, and the season it targets.
steps.check: build starts ahead of the season, not after

steps.name: Find the linked money page
steps.does: Confirm the one real money page the piece supports.
steps.check: a piece with no matching money page is not built

steps.name: Build the buying-guide body
steps.does: Structure by real decision criteria using proprietary data.
steps.check: data is tier-checked

steps.name: Build the comparison body
steps.does: State public, sourced, dated facts about the named competitor.
steps.check: every competitor fact is public, sourced and dated

steps.name: Confirm the cluster link (for a blog-type node)
steps.does: Confirm the pillar this piece belongs to and add sibling links.
steps.check: links to a real pillar

steps.name: Add FAQ and internal links
steps.does: Add real buyer questions and internal links.
steps.check: questions trace to real sources

steps.name: Run the claims gate
steps.does: Check every claim, including comparison statements.
steps.check: zero untraced claims, no competitor text copied

steps.name: Log the piece
steps.does: Register publish date and enter it into refresh tracking.
steps.check: entered into refresh tracking on publish

qa: Every competitor fact public, sourced, dated
Piece links to a real money page
read_point: next content-refresh cycle and SEO reporting cycle
subagents: content-production-worker: bulk drafting across a cluster

name: Run the content refresh and pruning program from revenue at risk
human_role: an SEO manager keeping existing pages healthy before writing anything new

steps.name: Pull page-level sessions and revenue
steps.does: Pull sessions and, where the order-join exists, page-level revenue.
steps.check: revenue join marked unavailable if it does not exist

steps.name: Rank by revenue at risk
steps.does: Rank the refresh backlog by revenue at risk first, traffic-only drops second.
steps.check: ranked in code, revenue first

steps.name: Check discontinued/out-of-stock pages
steps.does: Check every such page against the feed.
steps.check: none silently 404s

steps.name: Route discontinued pages
steps.does: Route to a redirect or an honest out-of-stock state.
steps.check: every item has a stated new destination or honest state

steps.name: Find duplicate/cannibalizing pages
steps.does: Find pages competing for the same target.
steps.check: candidates checked against real query overlap

steps.name: Recommend merge or canonical
steps.does: Recommend the fix, ranked by impact.
steps.check: ranked in code

steps.name: Name each refresh problem
steps.does: Name the specific problem behind each refresh candidate.
steps.check: no generic 'needs a refresh' without a specific reason

steps.name: Package the founder card
steps.does: Present the top refresh items with revenue at risk.
steps.check: revenue number is real, from the contract

qa: Backlog ranked by revenue at risk
Every candidate names its specific problem
read_point: next month, checking whether refreshed pages recovered revenue

name: Run the internal linking program
human_role: an SEO manager keeping link equity flowing to money pages

steps.name: Run the orphan check
steps.does: Find pages with zero internal links pointing to them.
steps.check: check covers the whole site

steps.name: Link content to money pages
steps.does: Add links from guides/blog to the money pages they support.
steps.check: every content page links to a real money page

steps.name: Link money pages back
steps.does: Add links from money pages back to relevant guides.
steps.check: links are topically relevant, not forced

steps.name: Add navigational links
steps.does: Add related-product/collection links on product and collection pages.
steps.check: links point to live, matching pages

steps.name: Fix or prune orphans
steps.does: Fix every orphan with a new link or hand to content-refresh for pruning.
steps.check: every orphan has a resolution, not left unaddressed

steps.name: Return the linking map
steps.does: Return what was added and what remains, with reasons.
steps.check: every remaining orphan states a reason

qa: Every content page links to a real money page
No orphan left unaddressed without a reason
Links checked live at build time
read_point: next SEO reporting cycle, crawl depth and orphan count

name: Run backlink, digital PR and mention outreach
human_role: a digital PR manager earning links through disclosed outreach
inputs_required: a real content asset or story to pitch

steps.name: Build the prospect list
steps.does: Build a list of relevant journalists, guest-post sites, broken-link targets, listicle/review editors.
steps.check: every prospect is relevant to the category

steps.name: Match pitches to prospects
steps.does: Match each to a real, disclosed pitch type.
steps.check: every pitch is a real, existing asset or story

steps.name: Draft personalized pitches
steps.does: Reference each prospect's actual past coverage.
steps.check: no mail-merge template

steps.name: Check for manipulative link risk
steps.does: Flag anything undisclosed or manipulative for the founder.
steps.check: nothing manipulative sends without a flag
steps.ask_founder_if: a pitch involves any paid or reciprocal link arrangement

steps.name: Log outreach
steps.does: Log date, prospect, pitch type, status for every send.
steps.check: every send has a status

steps.name: Track responses and placements
steps.does: Track responses and hand confirmed placements to link tracking.
steps.check: confirmed placements get a live link check

qa: Every send logged with a status
read_point: monthly, placements earned and link quality

name: Run local SEO and reputation program
trigger: weekly, for any brand with a physical location
human_role: a local SEO manager keeping the Google Business Profile and review flow healthy

steps.name: Confirm a physical location exists
steps.does: Check whether this brand has a physical location at all.
steps.check: workflow stops here if no physical location

steps.name: Check GBP accuracy
steps.does: Check hours, category, photos, posts, Q&A.
steps.check: every field checked against the real current status

steps.name: Check NAP consistency
steps.does: Check name, address, phone across directories.
steps.check: mismatches named exactly, with the wrong value

steps.name: Draft unincentivized review requests
steps.does: Draft a request sent after a verified purchase.
steps.check: no payment or discount offered for a review

steps.name: Draft review responses
steps.does: Draft responses to new reviews, especially negative ones, with a real next step.
steps.check: every negative review response names a next step

steps.name: Return the weekly status
steps.does: Package GBP, NAP and review status.
steps.check: nothing marked fine without being checked this week

read_point: monthly, review volume and rating trend

name: Report and diagnose SEO performance
human_role: an SEO manager running the fixed-cadence Search Console/GA4 read

steps.name: Pull the numbers
steps.does: Pull sessions, clicks, impressions, CTR, position, organic revenue from the contract.
steps.check: missing fields shown as unavailable

steps.name: Lead with revenue
steps.does: Structure the report to lead with organic revenue, not traffic.
steps.check: revenue is the first number shown

steps.name: Diagnose any drop
steps.does: Check CTR, device mismatch, engagement, position in that order for any drop.
steps.check: diagnosis names a specific mechanism with evidence

steps.name: Compare to the prior month
steps.does: Format as what we did, what it did, what is next.
steps.check: format matches the shared shape exactly

steps.name: Package and send
steps.does: Finalize the monthly report.
steps.check: reading level under grade 10

steps.name: Log the report
steps.does: Register the report and its numbers for next month's comparison.
steps.check: numbers stored match the contract exactly

read_point: monthly, fixed cadence

name: Vet SEO, link and AEO vendors before hiring
human_role: an SEO manager screening a vendor pitch before the founder signs

steps.name: List every vendor claim
steps.does: Extract every claim the vendor makes.
steps.check: no claim skipped

steps.name: Check for red flags
steps.does: Check each claim against known red flags (guarantees, PBNs, link farms).
steps.check: checked against a real red-flag list, not a gut feel

steps.name: Verify case studies
steps.does: Verify at least 2 claimed case studies independently.
steps.check: verified where possible, treated as a snapshot

steps.name: Check tactics against platform policy
steps.does: Check proposed tactics against current spam policies.
steps.check: checked against current policy

steps.name: Check AEO-specific vendors
steps.does: Check whether an AEO/GEO vendor runs a real repeatable audit or a one-off scan.
steps.check: distinguishes a repeatable method from a one-off resold as ongoing

steps.name: Score and recommend
steps.does: Score the vendor with a specific reason.
steps.check: reason is specific, not a gut feel

steps.name: Package the founder card
steps.does: Present the scorecard before any signature.
steps.check: card presented before any contract step

read_point: if hired: 90-day check against the vendor's own stated claims

name: Run the answer-engine probe, fix the facts page, and correct wrong answers
trigger: monthly (probe and facts page), event: wrong fact found (correction)
human_role: an AI-visibility owner keeping AI answers about the brand accurate

steps.name: Run the frozen prompt set
steps.does: Run each prompt on ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI by hand.
steps.check: every prompt run on every prioritized platform

steps.name: Classify each result
steps.does: Classify named/cited-with-link/cited-without-link/absent, and retrieval vs memory.
steps.check: classification never collapses to a single rank number

steps.name: Check persistence
steps.does: Recheck last month's citations to confirm they held.
steps.check: actually re-run, not assumed

steps.name: Classify gaps
steps.does: Classify each gap: missing, wrong, outdated, no coverage.
steps.check: every gap has supporting evidence

steps.name: Build or refresh the facts page
steps.does: Draft missing fact blocks answering the gaps, atomic and tier-checked.
steps.check: each block is atomic and sourced

steps.name: Check cross-surface consistency
steps.does: Check the same fact across site, schema, feed, directories, reviews.
steps.check: the same fact reads identically everywhere

steps.name: Fix a wrong fact at the source
steps.does: On a wrong fact found, fix the site first.
steps.check: site fixed before any outreach starts

steps.name: Draft publisher correction outreach
steps.does: Identify the likely publisher source and draft outreach.
steps.check: targets the actual likely source, not a guess

steps.name: Rewrite a page for citation, if needed
steps.does: For an existing high-value page an engine should cite but cannot, rewrite it answer-first.
steps.check: page still reads naturally, not fragmented

steps.name: Schedule a recheck
steps.does: Schedule re-running the engines after the fix.
steps.check: a real future date is set, not left open-ended

steps.name: Write the monthly report
steps.does: Write share-of-voice trend and top 3 gaps with recommended fixes.
steps.check: never reduces to a single rank number

qa: Report never reduces to a single rank number
read_point: the scheduled recheck date, and the next monthly cycle
typical_duration: agent: 1-2 days; sub-agent probing: several hours across platforms
subagents: ai-visibility-prober: drives the manual multi-platform prompting

name: Audit AI shopping agents against the claims tiers
human_role: an AI-visibility owner checking what shopping agents actually tell a buyer

steps.name: Query the agentic surfaces
steps.does: Query ChatGPT, Copilot, Google AI Mode, Gemini shopping with the frozen prompt set.
steps.check: every prompt run on every listed surface

steps.name: Record stated facts
steps.does: Record price, stock, shipping and product claims stated by each agent.
steps.check: recorded verbatim, not paraphrased

steps.name: Check against the live feed and claims tiers
steps.does: Compare stated facts to the live feed and claims tiers.
steps.check: checked against the live feed, not a cached value

steps.name: Route mismatches
steps.does: Route price/stock mismatches to the feed fix path, claim mismatches to fact-correction.
steps.check: each mismatch routed to the correct owner

steps.name: Log for trend tracking
steps.does: Log the week's results against prior weeks.
steps.check: logged weekly, not as a one-off

steps.name: Escalate a repeat mismatch
steps.does: If the same mismatch appears 2 weeks running, escalate to the founder since the routed fix did not take.
steps.check: escalation triggers only on a real repeat, not a single week
steps.ask_founder_if: the same mismatch repeats for 2 consecutive weeks

qa: Checked against the live feed, not cached
read_point: weekly, plus a monthly trend rollup with the AI-visibility report
